title: Casa di Pilatos
text: A fascinating tour of Casa di Pilatos with Manuela. She was full of interesting information that we would have missed if we had just looked around without a guide. It really brought the place to life. One small point would be to start nearer to the gate so that the traffic noise is not as interfering during the introduction and first part of the tour.
author: 839denm

title: Julián's perfection
text: Julián is perfection as a guide: vast culture and total pleasantness.
author: teguise05

title: Alvaro at Casa de Pilatos
text: Alvaro guided us through Casa de Pilatos and it was spectacular. He doesn't just stick to explaining the house, but he also explains history, art... You can tell he is passionate about his work and he knows how to convey that passion!
author: GrandTour51139999564

title: The great Álvaro at Casa de Pilatos
text: We took the guided tour with Álvaro and it was great. This guide had a great deal of knowledge about history and Casa de Pilatos. He knew how to convey it very well. It was a great pleasure to have him as a guide.
author: C4846KMannam

title: Álvaro great knowledge and good commentary
text: Wonderful tour with Álvaro, a lot of knowledge and the tour was very enjoyable.
author: S1244MQmariou

title: Incredible tour
text: Incredible tour! Full of interesting facts and easy access! Plus with the guide, Álvaro, who presents it in a fascinating way and makes history incredible and easy to understand
author: gabou699

title: Pilatos

title: Casa Pilatos visit
